questions.text: Our alarm system only emails when the freezer temperature drops, and nobody checks email on weekends. How do we get those alerts as texts?
I manage 40 field techs and they keep missing schedule changes because they don't read email on the road. What's the simplest fix?
Our monitoring tool sends email alerts at 2 a.m. that sit unread until morning. How can I turn them into text messages without code?
We lost a client because a server-down email went unnoticed over a long weekend. How do other small IT teams make sure alerts reach a phone?
My office manager sends the same urgent notice by email and then calls everyone who didn't read it. Is there a faster way to reach the whole team?
I run three clinic locations and need to tell staff about closures fast, but half of them never open the staff app. What should we use instead?
